summary: Sketch dimensions on the canvas are now selected before they are edited. Hovering a dimension's value, line or arrows highlights the points, lines, arcs and circles it measures; hovering a row in the relations or constraint issues list highlights the same geometry, including the origin or axis that a coordinate is measured from. A click selects one dimension and replaces the geometry selection, Shift toggles, Escape clears, and the status line names the selection. Double-click or Enter opens the existing editor; Space selects. Delete or Backspace removes the selected dimensions in one undo step through the same prepared edit as the relations list, and a refused removal keeps them with its message. A right-click menu offers Edit value…, Make reference or Make driving, and Delete; commands that do not apply stay visible, disabled, with the reason. Dimensions draw thinner: no label box, 1 px lines, slimmer arrows, quieter extension lines and haloed monospace values in theme colours, with reference values in parentheses and a dimmer colour. The size chips on older and plugin profiles follow the same rules: a click selects and highlights the leader, double-click or Enter edits, Delete removes a driving dimension, and the menu offers Edit value…, a disabled Make reference with its reason, and Delete. Accessible names change: canvas dimensions read Dimension or Reference dimension, the quantity and value, then press Enter to edit, instead of Configure or Inspect reference; profile chips read Dimension, the quantity and value, then press Enter to edit, instead of Edit and the quantity.
warning: Potentially breaking for automation and people that click a dimension expecting its editor: a click now only selects, and a double-click or Enter opens the editor. Automation that finds a canvas dimension by its accessible name must use the new names, for example Dimension distance 15 mm, press Enter to edit instead of Configure distance 15 mm, and Reference dimension diameter 6 mm, press Enter to edit instead of Inspect reference diameter 6 mm. Profile size chips change from Edit Width to Dimension width 30 mm, press Enter to edit. Delete with a dimension selected removes the dimension, not geometry. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD documents or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: removals use the existing remove-sketch-relation and remove-sketch-dimension edits, and conversions use set-sketch-relation with the existing reference-dimension, distance and radial-size kinds. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. Hover runs no solver or analysis call and renders only the highlight overlay. Menu commands are dropped when the part, version or sketch changed after the menu opened. WebMCP tools, their arguments and the viewport state they read are unchanged; dimension selection is not part of the agent viewport state.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Canvas dimensions and profile chips gain selection, hover highlight, Delete and a context menu; double-click or Enter opens the editor that a click opened before.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged and older releases open documents edited with this one.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest passed: 551 files, 6221 tests. New cadSketchDimensionSelection unit tests cover selection, reconciliation, status text, highlight targets and the hover store; CadSketchGraphDimensions, CadSketchCanvasRender, CadSketchDimensionControls, CadGearInteraction and CadWorkbench tests cover click selection, Shift toggles, Space, Escape, Enter and double-click editing, hover highlights from labels and relation rows, one-step Delete, refused removal messages, the context menu with disabled reasons, and that hover re-renders only the overlay. npm run build, npm run lint, npm run ui:check and node scripts/check-release.mjs origin/main pass. Chromium specs cad-sketch-dimension-selection (new), cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-reference-dimensions and cad-workflow passed 61 of 61. No controller or machine verification applies because output is unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch dimensions select on click and edit on double-click.
changes: Hover a dimension, or a row in the relations list, to highlight the geometry it measures, including the origin or axis for a coordinate.
Click a dimension to select it, Shift-click to add or remove one and Escape to clear. Double-click or press Enter to edit it.
Delete or Backspace removes the selected dimensions in one undo step. Right-click a dimension for Edit value…, Make reference or Make driving, and Delete; unavailable commands explain why.
Dimensions draw with thin lines and plain values; reference values show in parentheses in a dimmer colour.
The size chips on older and plugin profiles follow the same click, double-click, Delete and right-click rules.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches keep using existing relation and dimension kinds, so earlier releases open them. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: Double-click a dimension, or press Enter on it, where a single click used to open its editor. Automation that finds dimensions by accessible name should use the new names, such as Dimension distance 15 mm, press Enter to edit.
